title: Email misconversion of  8bit encoding after version154
creator: tishi
content:
So long as I investigated, the problem is,

After version154, received emails in Japanese encoded by 8bit causes misconversion (mojibake). Emails encoded by base64 is not misconverted. Only 8bit encoded shows the problem. Version153.5 is no problem. Version154 and newer shows the problem.

Here are OK/NG by sender/receiver combination. Sender version154 8bit - receiver version154 - NG Sender version154 base64 - receiver version154 - OK Sender version154 8bit - receiver version153 - OK Sender version154 base64 - receiver version153 - OK Sender version153 8bit - receiver version154 - OK Sender version153 base64 - receiver version154 - OK

Emails encoded by base64 is OK, but some senders can encode by only 8bit. I cannot find how they can use base64. It would be helpful to know to use base64 encoding in version154 (or later).

However, the best way is that version154 (or later) can read 8bit encoded email in Japanese. I would like to thank anyone who help the problem.

title: Microsoft login page never loads, authentication error
creator: olidino
content:
Title: Thunderbird 158 – Outlook.pt (IMAP, OAuth2): Microsoft login page never loads, authentication error

Hello,

I can't connect a personal Outlook.pt account (outlook.com) to Thunderbird. The Microsoft sign-in page never appears and I get "Authentication failed".

Environment - Thunderbird 158.0 (64-bit), also tested on Beta; Windows 11 - Browsers installed: Brave and Chrome (Chrome set as default for testing) - Account: personal @outlook.pt, no Microsoft 365 subscription

Settings used - IMAP: outlook.office365.com, port 993, SSL/TLS, OAuth2 - SMTP: smtp.office365.com, port 587, STARTTLS, OAuth2 - Username: full email address

What I have tried - Account setup test says "secure connection to outlook.office365.com:993 established successfully". - Automatic setup: no login window opens; the Error Console shows GuessConfig trying SMTP on port 465 (NS_ERROR_ABORT) and then "authentication failed". - Manual setup with OAuth2 forced: a browser window opens, but it stays on the browser's start page. Once, instead of Microsoft, it showed a Google consent page ("Mozilla Thunderbird Email wants to access your Google Account") for a Gmail address I use elsewhere, even though I was adding the Outlook account. - Clicking links inside emails correctly opens the browser, so the default-browser association works. - Cleared saved passwords/OAuth entries for outlook/office365/microsoft; removed and re-created the account several times. - Created a brand-new clean profile: same result. Thunderbird Beta: same result. - Microsoft account "recent activity" shows no sign-in attempt, so the request seems not to reach Microsoft. - Main profile has extensions (LanguageTool, flagged as incompatible, and CardBook). Not yet tested in Troubleshoot Mode. - Error Console shows no OAuth-related errors besides the GuessConfig lines above.

Questions - Why would Thunderbird open a Google consent page when adding an Outlook account? - Is there a known issue with OAuth2 for Outlook.com in version 158, or a hidden setting that could cause this?

Troubleshooting information from about:support is pasted below. Thank you.
